description: Straßenreinigung - Gemeinde Großbeeren (WFS) is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geoportal-grossbeeren.de. Representation of street cleaning including responsibilities in the municipal area (local locations). In principle, residents are responsible for winter maintenance and road cleaning on sidewalks and mixed traffic areas. Data base of the road network: OpenStreetMap (OSM) © OpenStreetMap contributors, CC-BY-SA. Coverage: the municipality of Großbeeren. The portal shows the English title as "Road cleaning - Municipality of Großbeeren (WFS)" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include infoFeatureAccessService, Straßenreinigung, opendata, Großbeeren. The listing shows 1 download or service links in WFS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
